def test_offline_docs(client):
    assert client.get("/docs").status_code == 200
    schema=client.get("/openapi.json").json()
    assert "/api/surveys/{sid}/stats/{qid}" in schema["paths"]
    assert "QuestionInput" in schema["components"]["schemas"]
    for asset in ("index.html","docs.html","app.js","docs.js","style.css"):
        content=(Path(__file__).parents[1]/"app"/"static"/asset).read_text(encoding="utf-8")
        assert "https://" not in content and "http://" not in content

def test_submit(client):
    h,sid,qid=setup_survey(client,anonymous=True)
    f=login(client,"filler")
    url="/api/fill/"+sid
    assert client.get(url).status_code == 401
    assert client.get(url,headers=f).status_code == 200
    assert client.post(url+"/next",headers=f,json={"answers":{}}).json()["next_question_id"] == qid
    assert client.post(url+"/submit",headers=f,json={"answers":{qid:200}}).status_code == 422
    assert client.post(url+"/submit",headers=f,json={"answers":{qid:20}}).status_code == 201
    assert client.post(url+"/submit",headers=f,json={"answers":{qid:21}}).status_code == 409
    rows=client.get("/api/surveys/"+sid+"/responses",headers=h).json()
    assert len(rows) == 1 and "respondent" not in rows[0] and "respondent_id" not in rows[0]
    assert "once_key" not in rows[0]
    assert client.get("/api/surveys/"+sid+"/responses",headers=f).status_code == 404

def test_statistics(client):
    h=login(client)
    sid=client.post("/api/surveys",headers=h,json={"title":"统计","allow_multiple":True,"anonymous":True}).json()["id"]
    base="/api/surveys/"+sid
    opts=[{"id":"a","label":"A"},{"id":"b","label":"B"}]
    for kind in ("single","multiple","text","number"):
        body={"title":kind,"type":kind}
        if kind in ("single","multiple"): body["options"]=opts
        client.post(base+"/questions",headers=h,json=body)
    qs=client.get(base,headers=h).json()["questions"]
    client.post(base+"/publish",headers=h)
    empty=client.get(base+"/stats",headers=h).json()
    assert empty["total_responses"] == 0 and empty["questions"][3]["average"] is None
    for values in (["a",["a","b"],"甲",10],["b",["b"],"乙",20]):
        answers={q["id"]:v for q,v in zip(qs,values)}
        assert client.post("/api/fill/"+sid+"/submit",headers=h,json={"answers":answers}).status_code == 201
    stats=client.get(base+"/stats",headers=h).json()
    assert stats["total_responses"] == 2
    assert [o["count"] for o in stats["questions"][0]["options"]] == [1,1]
    assert [o["count"] for o in stats["questions"][1]["options"]] == [1,2]
    assert stats["questions"][2]["values"] == ["甲","乙"]
    assert stats["questions"][3]["average"] == 15
    single=client.get(base+"/stats/"+qs[3]["id"],headers=h).json()
    assert single["average"] == 15 and single["answer_count"] == 2
    other=login(client,"other")
    assert client.get(base+"/stats",headers=other).status_code == 404
    assert client.get(base+"/stats/"+qs[3]["id"],headers=other).status_code == 404

@case('题目分享权限', '分享给另一账号；复用；尝试编辑、查看问卷答卷；撤销后再访问。', 'owner/alice、reader、stranger', '共享仅查看复用；撤销阻止新复用；已有快照仍可发布填写；使用清单不泄露他人问卷。')
def test_share_revoke_snapshot_and_usage_isolation(client):
    h,b,q=library(client)
    reader=login(client,'reader'); stranger=login(client,'stranger')
    owner_sid,_=import_into(client,h,q)
    base='/api/bank-questions/'+q['id']
    assert client.post(base+'/shares',headers=h,json={'username':'reader'}).status_code==200
    assert len(client.get('/api/shared-questions',headers=reader).json())==1
    shared=client.get(base,headers=reader).json()
    assert shared['bank_ids']==[] and 'shared_with' not in shared
    assert client.get(base+'/versions',headers=reader).status_code==200
    sid,instance=import_into(client,reader,q)
    before=client.app.state.db.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid})
    assert version(client,reader,q).status_code==404
    assert client.post(base+'/shares',headers=reader,json={'username':'stranger'}).status_code==404
    for suffix in ('','/responses','/stats'):
        assert client.get('/api/surveys/'+sid+suffix,headers=h).status_code==404
        assert client.get('/api/surveys/'+owner_sid+suffix,headers=reader).status_code==404
    assert [s['survey_id'] for s in client.get(base+'/usages',headers=h).json()]==[owner_sid]
    assert [s['survey_id'] for s in client.get(base+'/usages',headers=reader).json()]==[sid]
    assert client.get(base+'/usages',headers=stranger).status_code==404
    assert client.delete(base+'/shares/reader',headers=h).status_code==200
    assert client.get(base,headers=reader).status_code==404
    assert client.get('/api/shared-questions',headers=reader).json()==[]
    assert client.post(f'/api/surveys/{sid}/library-questions',headers=reader,json={'question_id':q['id'],'version_id':q['latest_version']['id']}).status_code==404
    assert client.app.state.db.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid})==before
    assert client.get(base+'/usages',headers=reader).status_code==200
    assert client.post(f'/api/surveys/{sid}/publish',headers=reader).status_code==200
    assert client.post(f'/api/fill/{sid}/submit',headers=reader,json={'answers':{instance['id']:12}}).status_code==201

cases.expected: 实例ID不同；原快照不自动更新；换版保持ID；发布后拒绝；答卷不变。
cases.source:
@case('复用快照', '同版本加入两次；创建新版本；显式换版；发布、提交后尝试换版。', '数字题V1、V2；答案键为实例ID', '实例ID不同；原快照不自动更新；换版保持ID；发布后拒绝；答卷不变。')
def test_snapshots_and_published_freeze(client):
    h,b,q=library(client)
    sid,a=import_into(client,h,q)
    _,bq=import_into(client,h,q,sid)
    assert len({a['id'],bq['id'],q['id'],q['latest_version']['id']}) == 4
    v=version(client,h,q).json()
    base=f'/api/surveys/{sid}'
    assert client.get(base,headers=h).json()['questions'][0] == a
    path=base+f'/questions/{a["id"]}/version'
    body={'question_id':q['id'],'version_id':v['id']}
    changed=client.put(path,headers=h,json=body).json()['questions'][0]
    assert changed['id']==a['id'] and changed['source']['version_id']==v['id']
    assert client.put(base+f'/questions/{a["id"]}',headers=h,json=v['content']).status_code == 409
    assert client.post(base+'/publish',headers=h).status_code == 200
    assert client.post(f'/api/fill/{sid}/submit',headers=h,json={'answers':{a['id']:10,bq['id']:20}}).status_code == 201
    d=client.app.state.db
    before=d.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid}); response=d.responses.find_one()
    assert client.put(path,headers=h,json=body).status_code == 409
    version(client,h,q,title='第三版',key='third')
    assert d.surveys.find_one({'_id':sid})==before and d.responses.find_one()==response

def test_separate_auth_views(client):
    pw = pytest.importorskip('playwright.sync_api')
    _, sid, _ = setup_survey(client)
    sock = socket.socket(); sock.bind(('127.0.0.1', 0))
    origin = f'http://127.0.0.1:{sock.getsockname()[1]}'
    app = create_app(Settings(mongo_uri=MONGO_URI, database=client.app.state.db.name))
    server = uvicorn.Server(uvicorn.Config(app, log_level='error'))
    thread = threading.Thread(target=server.run, kwargs={'sockets': [sock]}, daemon=True)
    thread.start()
    try:
        for _ in range(100):
            if server.started: break
            time.sleep(.1)
        assert server.started
        with pw.sync_playwright() as p:
            browser = p.chromium.launch(channel='msedge', headless=True)
            page = browser.new_page()
            errors = []; requests = []
            page.on('pageerror', lambda e: errors.append(str(e)))
            page.on('request', lambda r: requests.append(r.url) if r.url.endswith('/api/auth/register') else None)
            page.goto(origin)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#confirmPassword')).to_have_count(0)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_have_count(0)
            pw.expect(page.locator('#registration')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('请填写')
            page.locator('#username').fill('!bad')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名须')
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user')
            page.locator('#password').fill('short')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('密码长度')
            page.locator('#password').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('x'*17)
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('8～16个字符')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('different')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('不一致')
            assert requests == []
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#password')).to_have_value('')
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('UI_USER')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名已存在')
            assert client.app.state.db.users.count_documents({'username': 'ui_user'}) == 1
            page.locator('#backToLogin').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('ui_user'); page.locator('#password').fill('incorrect')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('用户名或密码错误')
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#new')).to_be_visible()
            old_token = page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')")
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            assert page.evaluate("sessionStorage.getItem('survey_token')") is None
            assert client.get('/api/auth/me', headers={'Authorization':'Bearer '+old_token}).status_code == 401
            page.goto(origin+'/survey/'+sid)
            page.locator('#register').click()
            page.locator('#username').fill('share_reader'); page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.locator('#confirmPassword').fill('password123'); page.locator('#submitRegistration').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#notice')).to_contain_text('注册成功')
            assert page.url == origin+'/survey/'+sid
            page.locator('#password').fill('password123')
            page.get_by_role('button', name='登录', exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            from app.auth import digest, now
            import secrets
            salt = secrets.token_hex(16)
            client.app.state.db.users.insert_one({'_id':'browser_legacy','username':'browser_legacy',
                'salt':salt,'password_hash':digest('L'*128,salt),'created_at':now()})
            page.locator('#logout').click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#auth')).to_be_visible()
            page.locator('#username').fill('browser_legacy')
            page.locator('#password').fill('L'*128)
            page.get_by_role('button',name='登录',exact=True).click()
            pw.expect(page.locator('#answerForm')).to_be_visible()
            assert errors == [], errors
            browser.close()
    finally:
        server.should_exit = True; thread.join(timeout=10); sock.close()
        assert not thread.is_alive()
